notes.title: Player's Shop
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Mechanics! 👋[/h1]

[h3]Welcome to the first devlog! We’re excited to start this journey together with all of you. We’re hopeful you’ll share many amazing ideas and insight along the way and together we’ll create a great game! 🤝[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/508da54b737a9ce5bdc69a91808fe82cc3c71aec.png[/img]
[h3]Gameplay 🎮[/h3]
The player manages a car shop in the game, where customers can buy car parts and get vehicles repaired in the workshop. The shop is the central hub of the player's business activities, combining management, trade, and customer interactions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/c9391504e9a7e34a31bb2d97c216092d0026078e.png[/img]
[h3]Shop Development 📝[/h3]
The player's shop can be upgraded over time. By investing in improvements, players can upgrade and maximize all the aspects of your business.
The main goal is to earn enough money to fully develop every aspect of the business, transforming it from a small store into a high-end workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/0983ca2d3a9a76cec5baa1c75d3fb4e790189e3e.png[/img]
[h3]Customer Service and Restocking 💻[/h3]
The player handles customer service and restocking the shop. Using a laptop, they order items, which are delivered in boxes. The player then unpacks these boxes and stocks the shelves manually. Efficient stock management ensures customers find what they need and keeps the business running smoothly.

Additionally, players must manage customer satisfaction by addressing their needs quickly and effectively. Providing excellent service can lead to positive reviews, attracting more customers.

[h3]Hiring Employees 🧑‍🔧[/h3]
Players can hire staff to improve efficiency:

[b]Cashier[/b]: Handles transactions with customers, allowing the player to focus on other tasks.
[b]Mechanic[/b]: Repairs vehicles in the workshop, helping you run this part of the business smoothly.

[h3]Motorcycle Sales 🏍️[/h3]
In addition to car parts and services, the player can sell motorcycles. This involves negotiating prices with interested customers, requiring the player to demonstrate strong sales skills. Successful negotiations can lead to higher profits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/b442010e43d9b857806fb9507213fe40e3f2abe0.png[/img]
That’s it for today! We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the premises of the game. If you’d like to take an active part in the process of producing the game make sure to leave us your comments, join our discord and add the game to your wishlist to get notified about every important news from the game! 💪

[url=https://discord.gg/TBQGEJU44W][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/357c75611e60db47c4b2339702ca6db4a1ed87cd.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401000/Car_Mechanic_Shop_Simulator/

See you soon
Car Mechanic Shop Simulator Team
